summary: Adds a discount_code field and an Order.apply_discount method. Adds order detail and redeem endpoints under the orders URLs.

findings.title: Order detail lookup ignores the owner
findings.problem: The order_detail view fetches the order by primary key alone. It never checks that request.user owns the order.
findings.consequence: Any logged-in user can read the total and discount code of every order by changing the id in the URL.
findings.fix: Add owner=request.user to the get_object_or_404 lookup, as the redeem view already does.

findings.title: Decimal total multiplied by a float
findings.problem: The apply_discount method multiplies a Decimal total by the float 0.9. Python raises TypeError when it mixes Decimal and float in multiplication.
findings.consequence: Every redeem request with the WELCOME10 code returns a server error. No user can ever apply the discount.
findings.fix: Multiply by Decimal("0.9") and quantize the result to two decimal places.

findings.title: New model field has no migration
findings.problem: The change adds discount_code to Order, but orders/migrations has only 0001_initial. That migration does not create a discount_code column.
findings.consequence: Every Order query selects a column the database lacks, so order_list, order_detail and redeem all fail.
findings.fix: Run makemigrations and commit the new migration that adds discount_code.

findings.title: CSRF protection disabled on a state-changing view
findings.problem: The redeem view changes an order and authenticates by session cookie. The decorator turns off CSRF checks for it.
findings.consequence: Any third-party site can make a logged-in user's browser submit redeem requests against that user's orders.
findings.fix: Remove the csrf_exempt decorator and send the CSRF token from the client.

findings.title: New discount and view behaviour has no tests
findings.problem: The change adds apply_discount, order_detail and redeem without any test. The repository contains no test files.
findings.consequence: A test would have caught the Decimal crash and the missing owner check before the push.
findings.fix: Add tests for discount application, repeat redemption, and access to another user's order.
